notes: The course says how much of the course it is. 36 of the College Board's 57 topics have lessons in this build, and until now the other 21 were simply absent: Unit 4 is 36 percent of the exam, five of its seventeen topics exist, and with the rest missing the unit read as finished. The map states the number at the top and names every missing topic under the unit it belongs to. Nothing else changes, because your progress and your questions were only ever about what is written.

The app no longer opens by saying it teaches the whole of AP Computer Science A, because it does not. That was a harmless thing to say to the person building it and the wrong thing to say to somebody revising off it.

The exam mode that was declared and never built is gone. Free response practice is real here, it is just not a timed section: it is the write and complete questions inside the course, each one showing the tests it is scored against before you start.
